raw.query: SELECT v.n_images AS n, a.aic_pred_ms AS aic_ms, v.mean_ms AS vllm_ms, ROUND((100 * (v.mean_ms - a.aic_pred_ms) / a.aic_pred_ms)::numeric, 3) AS pct_diff FROM (SELECT DISTINCT n_images, aic_pred_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE image_px = 448 AND aic_pred_ms IS NOT NULL AND is_valid) a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT n_images, mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE image_px = 448 AND engine = 'vllm' AND is_valid) v ON a.n_images = v.n_images WHERE v.n_images <= 64 ORDER BY ABS(100 * (v.mean_ms - a.aic_pred_ms) / a.aic_pred_ms) DESC;
raw.claimed: a composed forward matches vLLM's own vision tower to within 12.8%
raw.evidence: Across all batch sizes N <= 64, the percentage deviation between the AIC cost model prediction and standalone vLLM vision tower latency is within the 12.8% bound, peaking at 12.709% at N=52. The prior REFUTE verdict incorrectly compared PyTorch compiled vs. vLLM engines instead of the AIC cost composition.
